Record Class ModelFiles

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
org.clafer.frontend.ModelFiles
Record Components:
files - the files, in order, the model last
options - the options of all the files, combined
errors - the compiler's errors of reading the files and combining their options; the files are empty if there is one
public record ModelFiles(List<ModelFiles.ModelFile> files, ModelOptions options, List<String> errors) extends Record
The files of a model: the model and the files it imports, transitively, with --import=FILE in their //# OPTIONS lines, as the compiler reads them (Import.readModel): local files and http or https URLs (Http). An import is relative to the folder or the URL of the importing file; the imported files come before the files that import them, each once, and the model last. The model is their concatenation, and a line of it is shown in its file (position(int)). The web tools' restrictions of the imports are ModelFiles.ImportOptions.

      public static ModelFiles read(String path, List<String> commandLineImports, Function<String, Optional<String>> open)
      Reads a model and the local files it imports, taking the text of a file from open where it has one, e.g., a document open in an editor, and from disk otherwise. An import of a URL is an error (importsUrl()).
      Parameters:
      path - the model's file, as the messages show it
      commandLineImports - the imports given on the command line
      open - the text of a file, by its path as the model names it, if it is not to be read from disk

    • read

      public static ModelFiles read(String path, List<String> commandLineImports, Function<String, Optional<String>> open, ModelFiles.ImportOptions restrictions)
      Reads a model and the files it imports, as the compiler does (Import.readModel). The model is a file, a URL, or the standard input (Stdin, whose text open gives). The imports of the command line are relative to the working folder, and those of a file to its folder or URL, or, for the model, to --import-base. A file read from a URL may only import URLs.
      Parameters:
      path - the model's file or URL, as the messages show it
      commandLineImports - the imports given on the command line
      open - the text of a file, by its path, if it is not to be read
      restrictions - the restrictions of the imports
